of the IPC and Sections 3(1)(dha) 3 (1)(da), 3 (1)(w-i) 3(2) (v), 3(2) (va) of SC ST Act.
Earlier appeals were dismissed as withdrawn by this Court.

Accordingly, the instant appeal stands dismissed as withdrawn.

Accordingly, the instant appeal stands dismissed as withdrawn.
